TRIAL MOTION CALENDAR ON JAN-06-2004 IN 306 PURSUANT TO STIPULATION BY PARTIES. PETITION FOR WRIT OF ADMINISTRATIVE MANDATE SUBMITTED ON JAN-06-2004 BY KEVIN M. MCCARTHY. TENTATIVE RULING TO DENY REQUEST FOR INJUNCTION, BUT COURT TAKES THE MATTER UNDER SUBMISSION. PETITIONER ORALLY REQUESTS, AND FILES WITH THE CLERK A WRITTEN REQUEST FOR STATEMENT OF DECISION. COURT REMINDS PETITIONER THAT THIS IS A LAW AND MOTION MATTER WHICH LIMITS ABILITY OF THE COURT TO ISSUE A STATEMENT OF DECISION. COURT DECIDES TO RULE ON THE WRIT PETITION AND THEN HAVE EACH PARTY PREPARE A PROPOSED STATEMENT OF DECISION TO BE EXCHANGED BY COUNSEL ON FEBRUARY 3, 2004. COMMENTS AND PROPOSED STATEMENTS TO BE FILED WITH THE COURT ON FEBRUARY 10, 2004. JUDGE KEVIN M. MCCARTHY; CLERK MARILYN L. FLORES; COURT REPORTER MITCH LYONS CSR #6840 DEPT. 306.
